description: Dyfa wears a blue floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and narrow gold geometric woven borders along the bodice, cuffs, centre and hem. Round shoulder clasps, a decorated belt with round ornaments and a linked chain, a pendant and small hanging earrings accompany the gown. A pale ivory fringed wrap with blue and gold edging lies around her forearms. Closed brown shoes are visible. Her crown braids and loose lower hair are uncovered.
